project_title: 景德镇：千年窑火，一瓷一世界
category: 城市文旅宣传片 · 东方电影美学
creative_concept: 以『泥、火、釉、境、器、城』六重意象串联30秒，突破 Google Flow 单段秒数限制。全片通过【同心圆图形匹配】、【极速穿入开片裂纹】、【火光失焦光斑】与【前景立柱甩镜遮罩】四大无缝转场一气呵成，85%采用纯文生视频，仅在最具代表性的青花瓷主器物定格镜头启用首帧/首尾帧垫图以锁死器型与纹样。

visual_bible.camera_and_lens: ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 Anamorphic Lens (35mm & 100mm Macro)
visual_bible.lighting_and_color: Warm amber kiln firelight (3200K) contrasting with Song Dynasty Qingbai jade-cyan shadows (6500K), Kodak Vision3 500T color science
visual_bible.texture_and_atmosphere: Subtle 35mm organic film grain, floating clay dust motes in volumetric Tyndall light beams, tactile wet clay and crystalline ceramic glaze reflections
visual_bible.style_suffix_en: Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber kiln rim lighting contrasting with deep jade-cyan shadows, volumetric atmospheric mist, cinematic commercial color grading, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic, 8k, smooth gimbal movement.

product_dna.subject_lock_en: museum-grade Ming-style blue-and-white porcelain vase (Qinghua Meiping), translucent ivory-white jade-like glaze, cobalt-blue hand-painted swirling cloud and dragon motifs, delicate golden ice-crackle glaze network (Jinsi Tiexian)
product_dna.materials_and_reflections: 半透明玉质感白釉底、深邃苏麻离青钴蓝晕染、高光处有细腻的冰裂纹（金丝铁线）玻璃态镜面反光
product_dna.ingredients_strategy: 第 1~4 镜与第 6 镜均使用【T2V 纯文生】直接生成；仅在第 5 镜（核心国宝级青花梅瓶特写向御窑博物馆过渡）建议上传一张青花瓷定妆图至 Google Flow Ingredients（或使用下方提供的首帧 Prompt 生成），确保青花纹饰不乱飘、瓶身比例端庄对称。

audio_guide.bgm_style: 0-8秒为空灵古琴泛音与湿润陶土旋转ASMR；8-20秒随着窑火燃起加入低沉大提琴独奏与冰裂纹清脆开片声；20-30秒恢弘东方交响乐与现代电子低频共振推向高潮，尾声以一声清越的瓷音定格。
audio_guide.bgm_prompt_en: Cinematic oriental luxury commercial soundtrack, starts with intimate tactile ASMR and ethereal Guqin harmonics, building at 8 seconds with deep emotional cello and crackling fire, climaxing at 20 seconds with epic modern orchestral strings and deep sub-bass pulse, ending with a single pure resonant porcelain chime, Wong Kar-wai meets Apple commercial score, 92 BPM.

shots.phase_name: 黄金3秒钩子 · 指尖生泥
shots.gen_mode_reason: 湿润高岭土与飞溅水滴属于流体/材质微距镜头，Google Flow 纯文生表现力极强，无需垫图。
shots.visual_summary_zh: 暗室丁达尔暖光下，老匠人苍劲的双手在高速旋转的拉坯机上按压出湿润的同心圆陶碗。
shots.visual_detail_zh: 90度垂直俯拍微距（Top-down Macro）。一束琥珀色侧逆光刺破暗室青色阴影，湿润细腻的高岭土在转盘中心高速旋转。匠人布满岁月纹理的双手稳稳向中心施力，晶莹的水珠与泥浆微粒沿切线慢动作飞溅。最后1秒镜头顺时针旋转急速推入圆形碗心。
shots.camera_movement_zh: 垂直90度俯拍 + 顺时针缓慢旋转并加速推进至圆形陶坯正中心（Top-down overhead spiraling push-in）
shots.entry_bridge_zh: 开篇首镜：黑场中一声清脆水滴声，琥珀色逆光骤然点亮旋转的泥坯。
shots.transition_to_next_zh: 镜头结尾急速推进，使旋转的圆形陶碗内壁占满画面中央80%，与下一镜【圆形古柴窑穹顶天窗】形成1:1同心圆图形与顺时针旋转动势无缝匹配。
shots.flow_video_prompt_en: Extreme close-up 90-degree overhead top-down shot of weathered artisan hands shaping wet spinning porcelain clay on a potter's wheel. Shimmering water droplets and fine clay mist fly off the spinning circular rim in slow motion. At the end of the shot, the camera accelerates in a clockwise spiral push-in directly into the dark circular center of the clay bowl until the circle fills the center frame. Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber kiln rim lighting contrasting with deep jade-cyan shadows, volumetric atmospheric mist, cinematic commercial color grading, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic, 8k, smooth gimbal movement.
shots.voiceover_zh: 一捧高岭土，在掌心苏醒。
shots.sfx_zh: 转盘低频嗡鸣、湿润泥浆摩挲声、慢动作水滴飞溅声
shots.sfx_prompt_en: Tactile wet clay spinning on potter wheel, slow motion water droplets splashing, deep warm room ambiance

shots.phase_name: 笔尖入魂 · 青花晕染
shots.gen_mode_reason: 毛笔在素坯上晕染钴蓝颜料的微距动态，纯文生能自然呈现水墨渗透肌理。
shots.visual_summary_zh: 从圆形素坯中心拉出，狼毫画笔饱蘸钴蓝料水，在洁白素坯上勾勒出流云纹，镜头最后极速扎入笔尖墨迹。
shots.visual_detail_zh: 镜头从画面中央的圆形素坯纹理顺时针旋转拉出（承接上一镜）。一支极细的狼毫画笔悬空落下，笔尖饱含深邃的苏麻离青料水，在干燥细腻的白色素坯表面轻轻一触，钴蓝色料水瞬间在微孔中如云雾般蔓延渗透。最后1秒镜头极速微距推进（Speed-ramp macro dive）直接扎入深蓝色的墨迹纹理内部。
shots.camera_movement_zh: 从圆形中心旋转拉出转为侧面超微距跟拍画笔，结尾极速推入钴蓝墨迹深处（Pull back from circle to macro tracking, ending in speed-ramp dive into ink）
shots.entry_bridge_zh: 承接上一镜同心圆旋转动势：从圆形素坯盘心顺滑拉出。
shots.transition_to_next_zh: 结尾镜头极速推入深蓝色青花墨迹直至画面全暗，下一镜从暗蓝窑膛深处猛然燃起赤金窑火穿出。
shots.flow_video_prompt_en: Starts tightly framed on a spinning circular white ceramic plate center in a clockwise motion, smoothly pulling back to an extreme macro side-angle as a fine calligraphy brush dipped in deep cobalt-blue pigment touches the porous white clay surface. The blue ink blooms organically across the texture. In the final second, the camera executes a rapid speed-ramp push-in diving directly into the dark blue ink stroke filling the entire screen. Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber kiln rim lighting contrasting with deep jade-cyan shadows, volumetric atmospheric mist, cinematic commercial color grading, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic, 8k, smooth gimbal movement.
shots.voiceover_zh: 落笔千钧，藏山河于方寸。
shots.sfx_zh: 狼毫笔尖触碰素坯的细微沙沙声、水分瞬间渗透吸收的微距声效
shots.sfx_prompt_en: Macro calligraphy brush touching dry porous clay, subtle liquid absorption fizz, quiet breath

shots.phase_name: 烈火涅槃 · 千度窑变
shots.gen_mode_reason: 火焰流体与高温釉面融化光效是 Veo / Google Flow 最擅长的物理光影强项。
shots.visual_summary_zh: 千年柴窑深处烈焰翻涌，1300度高温下瓷器表面釉水熔融流淌，最终化作漫天金色眩光光斑。
shots.visual_detail_zh: 镜头从幽暗窑膛向前穿出，赤金色的松柴烈焰在古老砖窑内翻滚咆哮。特写火焰舔舐过瓷坯表面，原本哑光的青花素坯在1300度高温下发生奇妙窑变，表面渐渐浮现出晶莹剔透的液态玻璃釉光。镜头末尾焦点缓缓虚化（Rack focus out），翻涌的火星与金色火光充满整个镜头，化作璀璨的圆形奶油色散景光斑（Bokeh）。
shots.camera_movement_zh: 向前缓慢推轨穿过火焰屏障，环绕受热的瓷器局部，结尾大光圈失焦（Slow dolly forward through flames, ending in full golden bokeh defocus）
shots.entry_bridge_zh: 承接上一镜微距穿入：从深邃暗部向前冲出，被迎面而来的金色窑火点亮。
shots.transition_to_next_zh: 画面在漫天温暖的金色大光圈失焦光斑（Golden Bokeh）中结束，下一镜从清晨瑶里古镇江面的金色波光光斑中由虚变实聚焦。
shots.flow_video_prompt_en: Camera emerges forward from dark shadows into the roaring interior of an ancient brick wood-fired kiln. Golden pine flames swirl in slow motion around a glowing porcelain vessel as its matte surface melts into a shimmering, translucent liquid glass glaze under intense heat. Glowing embers float upward. At the end of the shot, the lens racks completely out of focus, turning the roaring golden fire and sparks into soft, dreamy circular golden bokeh light orbs filling the frame. Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber kiln rim lighting contrasting with deep jade-cyan shadows, volumetric atmospheric mist, cinematic commercial color grading, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic, 8k, smooth gimbal movement.
shots.voiceover_zh: 千度烈焰，淬炼不灭的温润。
shots.sfx_zh: 低沉轰鸣的柴窑烈火声、松木爆裂声、高温热浪空气震颤声
shots.sfx_prompt_en: Roaring kiln fire in slow motion, pine wood crackling, deep sub-bass heat rumble

shots.phase_name: 烟雨瑶里 · 冰裂听音
shots.gen_mode_reason: 古镇晨雾山水与青白釉面光影交融，纯文生配合快速甩镜遮罩可实现丝滑空间转换。
shots.visual_summary_zh: 金色波光由虚变实，展现晨雾笼罩的瑶里古镇廊桥流水，镜头向右快速甩镜掠过古建木柱完成遮罩。
shots.visual_detail_zh: 画面从满屏金色散景光斑（承接上一镜火光）平滑对焦（Rack focus in），原来是清晨阳光洒在瑶里古镇碧绿河面上的粼粼波光。远方黛瓦白墙的徽派古村落笼罩在青色晨雾与炊烟之中，一叶竹筏缓缓划破如青白瓷釉般温润的水面。第5秒时，摄影机向右急速甩镜（Fast whip pan right），贴近掠过廊桥一根深色古木立柱，深色木柱瞬间占满全屏形成天然黑场遮罩。
shots.camera_movement_zh: 由虚变实对焦江面 → 贴水面向前滑行 → 结尾急速向右甩镜贴过深色前景木柱（Rack focus in, low-angle water glide, fast whip pan right behind dark pillar）
shots.entry_bridge_zh: 承接上一镜金色火光光斑：从完全失焦的金色光斑中缓缓对焦至清晨江面波光。
shots.transition_to_next_zh: 结尾摄影机快速向右甩镜并被前景深色古木柱完全遮挡画面；下一镜以完全相同的向右甩镜速度从深色前景遮挡后方滑出，揭示博物馆展厅中的传世青花梅瓶。
shots.flow_video_prompt_en: Starts completely out of focus with glowing golden bokeh orbs, then smoothly racks focus into sharp detail on sunlight shimmering across a jade-green river in Yaoli ancient town, Jingdezhen. Traditional white-walled, black-tiled heritage houses sit nestled in cyan morning mist as a bamboo raft glides across the mirror-like water. In the final second, the camera executes a rapid whip pan to the right, passing inches behind a dark wooden bridge pillar that momentarily fills the entire frame in dark motion blur. Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber kiln rim lighting contrasting with deep jade-cyan shadows, volumetric atmospheric mist, cinematic commercial color grading, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic, 8k, smooth gimbal movement.
shots.voiceover_zh: 天青色等烟雨，而千年在等你。
shots.sfx_zh: 清脆悦耳的瓷器冰裂开片声（叮——）与悠远水声、清晨鸟鸣交织
shots.sfx_prompt_en: Delicate crystalline porcelain ice-crackle chime merging with gentle river water flow and distant morning birds

shots.phase_name: 器成天下 · 传世定格
shots.gen_mode_reason: ⚠️ 关键主体锚定镜：本镜展示核心青花云龙纹梅瓶细节，建议使用下方提供的首帧 Prompt 先生成高精定妆图（或上传实拍图）作为 Google Flow 首帧，彻底杜绝青花图案变形。
shots.visual_summary_zh: 从深色前景向右甩镜滑出，一尊温润如玉的青花梅瓶静立于光束中，镜头环绕升起并仰拍其圆润瓶口。
shots.visual_detail_zh: 摄影机延续向右甩镜的惯性从深色前景阴影后方滑出并平稳减速，稳稳环绕一尊陈列于暗调光束中的明代风格青花云龙纹梅瓶。一束琥珀色追光掠过半透明的白釉与细腻的冰裂纹，青花钴蓝纹饰层次分明。镜头最后向上缓缓升起并转为仰拍，使梅瓶浑圆的瓶口轮廓与上方红砖拱顶产生几何呼应。
shots.camera_movement_zh: 从右侧甩镜减速进入环绕轨道（Orbit tracking），随后平滑上升并仰拍拱形穹顶（ Crane up and tilt up）
shots.entry_bridge_zh: 承接上一镜向右甩镜遮罩：从左侧深色前景遮挡物后方高速向右滑出并减速定焦于梅瓶。
shots.transition_type: MATCH_SHAPE + MOTION_RELAY (仰拍弧线动势接力)
shots.transition_to_next_zh: 结尾镜头向上仰拍环绕圆形瓶口与红砖弧线，下一镜直接接力向上仰拍滑行的运镜动势，冲出御窑博物馆标志性的红砖双曲拱顶建筑群。
shots.flow_video_prompt_en: Camera emerges from behind a dark foreground silhouette in a fast whip pan right, decelerating into a smooth orbital track around a museum-grade Ming-style blue-and-white porcelain vase (Qinghua Meiping) with translucent ivory-white glaze and cobalt-blue cloud motifs. A warm amber spotlight sweeps across its delicate golden ice-crackle glaze texture. At the end of the shot, the camera cranes upward and tilts up toward the circular rim and a warm red-brick arch above. Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber kiln rim lighting contrasting with deep jade-cyan shadows, volumetric atmospheric mist, cinematic commercial color grading, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic, 8k, smooth gimbal movement.
shots.keyframe_image_prompt_en: Commercial museum hero shot of a masterpiece Ming-style blue-and-white porcelain Meiping vase standing on a dark obsidian pedestal, translucent jade-white glaze with intricate cobalt-blue hand-painted swirling clouds, subtle golden crackle glaze texture, dramatic warm amber rim spotlight piercing through a dark cyan-shadowed brick vault, ARRI Alexa 65, 85mm macro lens, photorealistic, 8k --ar 16:9
shots.sfx_zh: 庄重空灵的交响弦乐渐强，伴随一记清澈悠长的瓷器共鸣声
shots.sfx_prompt_en: Deep orchestral strings swell, pure resonant porcelain ring echoing in a grand hall

shots.phase_name: 高潮升华 · 御窑夜色与品牌落版
shots.gen_mode_badge: T2V 纯文生 (可配合 SceneBuilder Extend)
shots.gen_mode_reason: 宏大建筑航拍与湖面镜像收尾，纯文生即可呈现极具视觉冲击力的蓝调时刻（Blue Hour）城市大片感。
shots.visual_summary_zh: 接力仰拍冲出景德镇御窑博物馆红砖拱顶，航拍拉升展现蓝调夜色下倒映于镜面水池中的千年瓷都盛景。
shots.visual_detail_zh: 镜头延续向上仰拍升起的动势，从景德镇御窑博物馆标志性的红砖窑拱内部穿出至开阔夜空，随即转为宏大的无人机航拍后拉（Aerial pull-back reveal）。深邃的蓝调时刻（Blue Hour）夜幕下，数座温润如巨型柴窑的红砖拱体建筑内部透出温暖的琥珀色灯光，完美倒映在如镜面般的环绕水池中。画面中央留出干净呼吸感构图，供后期叠加『中国·景德镇』书法Slogan。
shots.camera_movement_zh: 从拱顶向上穿出转为大范围航拍向后拉升俯瞰全景（Upward reveal transitioning into sweeping aerial drone pull-back）
shots.entry_bridge_zh: 承接上一镜向上仰拍红砖拱顶的动势：镜头无缝向上穿出红砖拱门，视野豁然开朗。
shots.transition_to_next_zh: 成片收尾镜头：航拍缓慢拉远至对称构图，水面波光微漾，音乐余音绕梁中淡出黑场并浮现品牌落版。
shots.flow_video_prompt_en: Continuing an upward rising camera motion, the lens emerges above the iconic curved red-brick kiln arches of the Jingdezhen Imperial Kiln Museum at twilight blue hour, seamlessly transitioning into a sweeping aerial drone pull-back shot. Warm amber interior lights glow from within the monumental organic brick vaults, reflecting symmetrically in the tranquil mirror-like water pools below against a deep cyan twilight sky. Clean balanced composition in the center sky for title overlay. Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber kiln rim lighting contrasting with deep jade-cyan shadows, volumetric atmospheric mist, cinematic commercial color grading, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic, 8k, smooth gimbal movement.
shots.voiceover_zh: 千年窑火生生不息——中国·景德镇。
shots.sfx_zh: 交响乐达到恢弘顶点后骤然收束，留下一声余韵悠长的古琴泛音与清脆瓷鸣
shots.sfx_prompt_en: Epic orchestral climax resolving into a single long resonant porcelain chime and gentle evening breeze
